login_tagline: See the talent. Meet the person.

login_panel_description: Understand the person behind the experience. Discover what they could bring to your team.
home_brand_origin: Inspired by the Japanese word 才能 (sainō), meaning talent. Sainoa is a coined name for a companion that helps you recognize people’s abilities and potential.
home_document_description: The next recruiting agent for hiring teams, connecting resume screening, AI interviews, human interviews, and candidate decisions.
home_hero_description: Start from the role and see who fits, faster. AI screens, asks, and organizes evidence. Your team makes the call.
home_trust_lead: The judgments that matter most stay with your hiring team. Every conclusion has a source, and every piece of data has a boundary.
home_trust_decision_description: AI only suggests and cites. Advancing, hiring, or closing a process is always confirmed by your team.
home_trust_source_description: Every strength and risk cites its source: which resume page, which interview answer.
home_trust_data_description: Resumes, interview records, and evaluations stay in their workspace and are visible by member permissions.
home_faq_title: A few things to make clear first.
home_faq_q1: Where are resumes and interview records stored?
home_faq_a1: In your workspace, where they support screening, interviews, and team review. Only members with access can view or manage them.
home_faq_q2: Does AI make the final hiring decision?
home_faq_a2: No. AI organizes evidence, asks follow-ups, and offers guidance. Advancing, hiring, or closing a candidate is always your team's call.
home_faq_q3: Can each role use different screening and interview criteria?
home_faq_a3: Yes. Configure responsibilities, requirements, interview focus, and question templates per role. The clearer the context, the closer screening and follow-ups match your standards.
home_features_title: Turn complex recruiting work into a few clear actions.
home_features_lead: No digging through a back office. Each step shows only what needs a decision and carries the evidence forward.
home_feature_evidence_description: More than a score. Strengths, risks, and role fit all trace back to specific resume experience.
home_feature_evidence_point_one: Link every point to resume text
home_feature_chat_title: AI goes first and asks what matters.
home_feature_chat_description: The AI interviewer asks role-based questions by voice and follows up on each answer, tying every reply back to the resume.
home_feature_human_title: Walk in with evidence. Ask what matters.
home_feature_human_description: Evidence confirmed in the AI interview and open questions become this round's focus, so interviewers know what to ask before they join.
home_feature_team_description: Scores, risks, answer evidence, and team notes share one view. Everyone discusses the same facts, not separate impressions.
app_not_found_title: This page could not be found.
app_not_found_description: The page may have moved. Head back to the homepage to continue.
home_capability_pipeline_description: Resume screening, AI interview, live interview: always know where each candidate stands.
home_capability_followup_description: When an answer is vague, the AI interviewer asks for examples, roles, and results until it is specific.
home_feature_human_point_two: Scheduling and feedback in one place
home_persona_hr_description: Set the role context and move candidates through screening, AI, and live interviews. Every candidate's progress is visible.
home_capability_schedule_description: Times, interviewers, and feedback for live interviews in one calendar.
home_cta_lead: Upload a batch of resumes and see how AI organizes evidence against the role.
home_roles_title: Recruiters and candidates each get their own entry.
home_capability_lead: Roles, candidates, interviews, and data live in one place. Change the step, not the tool.
home_faq_q4: How do recruiters and candidates access the product?
home_capability_context_description: Set requirements, screening focus, and interview questions once. Switch roles and every later step follows.
home_persona_candidate_description: No sign-up. Open the link to start the AI interview, follow the prompts, and focus on answering.
home_capability_title: One workspace for every step of hiring.
home_capability_dashboard_description: Pipeline distribution, intake trends, and AI interview conversion on one page.
home_faq_a5: Use a modern browser such as Chrome, Edge, or Safari, a stable connection, and headphones. The microphone is checked before the interview starts.
home_capability_link_description: No sign-up. Candidates open their private link and start the AI interview.
home_capability_context_title: One role context, reused end to end
home_roles_lead: HR runs the process, hiring managers review evidence, and candidates just open a link. Three roles, one record.
home_persona_manager_description: Go straight to resume evidence, key answers, and risk flags. Spend time only on what needs human judgment.
home_faq_q5: What device or network does a voice interview require?
home_faq_a4: Your team signs in to run the workflow. Candidates join the AI interview through a private link, no sign-up needed.
